# Folsom Cost to Own

> Folsom Cost to Own is a free Folsom, CA guide by Scott Kirk, Broker/Owner, Weichert, Realtors - Sierra Pacific Group (CA DRE 01879787, corporate DRE 02088790), 705 Gold Lake Dr., Suite 250, Folsom, CA 95630, 916-847-5822, scott@wrspg.com. Every figure comes from MetroList (the regional MLS) or a named public record, with the source listed on the page. Data updated November 2026.

## Pages

- [Cost to Own a Home in Folsom, CA by Neighborhood: Property Tax, Mello-Roos, HOA](https://folsomcosttoown.com/): The yearly cost to own a home in each Folsom, CA neighborhood: 2026-27 property tax rates, Mello-Roos from real county bills, and HOA dues from MetroList. By Scott Kirk.
- [Folsom Mello-Roos by District: Rates, Neighborhoods, End Dates](https://folsomcosttoown.com/mello-roos/): Every Mello-Roos district in Folsom, CA we found: which neighborhoods it covers, the rate for a home, the yearly increase and when it ends. Linked to City of Folsom and county documents.
- [HOA Dues in Folsom, CA by Neighborhood | Folsom Cost to Own](https://folsomcosttoown.com/hoa-dues/): Median monthly HOA dues in each Folsom, CA neighborhood, from MetroList sales, and which neighborhoods reported none.
- [Supplemental Tax Bill in Folsom, CA: How Much and When It Comes](https://folsomcosttoown.com/supplemental-tax-bill/): How the Sacramento County supplemental tax bill works when you buy a Folsom home, with the county's monthly factors and examples for north Folsom and Folsom Ranch.
- [Russell Ranch Mello-Roos and Property Tax, Folsom CA | 2026-27 Bills](https://folsomcosttoown.com/russell-ranch/): Mello-Roos, district charges, base tax and HOA dues for Russell Ranch in Folsom, CA, from a real 2026-27 Sacramento County bill and MetroList sales.
- [Mangini Ranch Mello-Roos and Property Tax, Folsom CA | 2026-27 Bills](https://folsomcosttoown.com/mangini-ranch/): Mello-Roos, district charges, base tax and HOA dues for Mangini Ranch in Folsom, CA, from a real 2026-27 Sacramento County bill and MetroList sales.
- [Regency at Folsom Ranch Mello-Roos and Property Tax, Folsom CA | 2026-27 Bills](https://folsomcosttoown.com/regency-folsom-ranch/): Mello-Roos, district charges, base tax and HOA dues for Regency at Folsom Ranch in Folsom, CA, from a real 2026-27 Sacramento County bill and MetroList sales.
- [White Rock Springs Ranch Mello-Roos and Property Tax, Folsom CA | 2026-27 Bills](https://folsomcosttoown.com/white-rock-springs-ranch/): Mello-Roos, district charges, base tax and HOA dues for White Rock Springs Ranch in Folsom, CA, from a real 2026-27 Sacramento County bill and MetroList sales.
- [Empire Ranch Mello-Roos and Property Tax, Folsom CA | 2026-27 Bills](https://folsomcosttoown.com/empire-ranch/): Mello-Roos, district charges, base tax and HOA dues for Empire Ranch in Folsom, CA, from a real 2026-27 Sacramento County bill and MetroList sales.
- [The Parkway Mello-Roos and Property Tax, Folsom CA | 2026-27 Bills](https://folsomcosttoown.com/the-parkway/): Mello-Roos, district charges, base tax and HOA dues for The Parkway in Folsom, CA, from a real 2026-27 Sacramento County bill and MetroList sales.
- [Common Questions | Folsom Cost to Own](https://folsomcosttoown.com/questions/): Short, sourced answers about the yearly cost of owning a home in Folsom: property tax, Mello-Roos and HOA dues, by Scott Kirk, Weichert, Realtors - Sierra Pacific Group.
- [Folsom Property Tax, Mello-Roos and HOA by the Numbers | Folsom Cost to Own](https://folsomcosttoown.com/numbers/): Sourced figures on Folsom, CA property tax rates, Mello-Roos district charges, HOA dues and the supplemental bill, one per line with date and source. By Scott Kirk.
- [Video: What It Really Costs to Own a Home in Folsom | Scott Kirk](https://folsomcosttoown.com/video/): Scott Kirk walks through the two Folsom tax rates, every Mello-Roos district with its end date, HOA dues by neighborhood, the supplemental bill, and how to check one house yourself.
- [Sources and Method | Folsom Cost to Own](https://folsomcosttoown.com/method/): Where every number on Folsom Cost to Own comes from.
